item.title: Project 2: Multiples and variation
item.content:
Produce a series of at least five objects in which variation is designed — parametric, generative, or rule-based — and the series says something the single object cannot. Budget your print time; batch your jobs.

Theme: Multiples and variation

A series or edition in which variation is designed: a parametric family, a generative system, a set that changes across instances.

Techniques: Parametric CAD; generative/scripted variation; FDM printing; batching

What to hand in

  • The series
  • The system: parameters/rules and how they map to the objects
  • Process documentation incl. print budget vs. actual

What you'll practise

  • Design a system, not an object
  • Manage production across many jobs
  • Present a series with intent

Time: 3 weeks + crit
